main_body: Flat ground patch of mottled green texture, filling the whole 64x48 area (the object is named desert, but hue is not judged)
top_band: none. The column scan shows only repeating green texture rows (L=85 to 170) with no top band and no front face, as expected for a ground tile
evidence: This is terrain, a flat ground surface seen from above, not a standing object. The top/front-face contract does not apply, and nothing is drawn as an elevation or a plank. The pattern is a seamless texture with no volume to judge.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 5 distinct colours and a median of 5 colours per tile. The grass reference has 80 colours and a median of 26 per tile. The ramp is mid green, dark green, light green and a highlight, scattered in small regular speckle and dark-clump motifs. Clumps repeat on a visible grid with little per-clump shading, so it reads as a mechanical stamp. 5x5 flat-fill coverage is 0%, so there are no flat areas, and there is no outline. Even so, density is far below the grass reference of the same kind, so it looks thinner and flatter next to it.
